components.name: psycopg
components.source_form: the wheel's Python modules are the source; installed unmodified under site-packages/psycopg

build_instructions: Install the target's C compiler and the libpq5/libpq-dev pair of one version (pg_config included).
components.form: C extension compiled from the source archive below and dynamically linked to the system libpq.so.5
components.generated_c: attributed to the hash-bound archive; not regenerated (no Cython)
components.name: psycopg-c
components.replacement: psycopg_c/_psycopg and psycopg_c/pq are separate Python extension modules loaded at run time from site-packages/psycopg_c; they link libpq.so.5 dynamically (DT_NEEDED) and may be rebuilt from the source above and reinstalled in place. RepoMap imports only the psycopg package interface and does not modify Psycopg.
